[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Invest in a cord management system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Set aside time each week to tidy up cords and cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Use a power strip with built-in cord organizers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Consider switching to wireless devices to reduce cords.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Regularly dust the area behind the TV.
